assembly_state.rationale: The box is the colchicine site, at the intradimer interface.

engines._note: Example: no measured affinity is declared for this pair, so the engine's score is not calibrated here. Declare experimental_kd[].state before treating a score as an affinity.

control.rationale: Cytochalasin D binds the barbed-end cleft of ACTIN (co-crystal 3EKS). It has no site on tubulin: a high affinity here would signal an overly wide box or a score inflated by ligand volume.
